subject: Post-demo: Buying roles, procurement route, and security-scope kickoff
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — buyer roles + security kickoff

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the clear questions on data flow and retention. Quick recap and asks so we keep momentum: 

- Attendees: Susan Park (VP Product), Alex Jensen (Security), me (Camila).
- Goal: Confirm buying roles, procurement path, and scope for the security intake so your team can kick off an internal review.

Action items for Acme (requested):
1) Confirm economic buyer and procurement contact (name + email).
2) Confirm which systems are in scope for the initial evaluation (examples below).
3) Have your security team start the preliminary questionnaire — attached is our short intake form (redwood-prelim-questionnaire.pdf). If it helps, Alex, feel free to prefill the relevant sections and we’ll iterate.

Suggested initial scope (please confirm):
- Production app servers that will call Redwood-hosted inference endpoints
- Customer PII datastore (RDS) — read-only for embeddings ingestion
- Telemetry/metrics pipeline (CloudWatch / BigQuery) for observability

Timing: would you prefer a formal security kickoff this week (30–45 min) or next week?

I’ve attached the questionnaire and a placeholder NDA DocuSign link — we can start the security sync once procurement signals are OK.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Diego (solutions) and Marcus (sales lead) for procurement and SOW questions.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-prelim-questionnaire.pdf, nda-docusign-link.txt

From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — buyer roles + security kickoff

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and clarifications from security’s side: 

- Systems in scope for the first pass:
  * App API (k8s cluster in our us-west-2 account) that will call the Redwood API
  * Embeddings ingestion pipeline (ETL into our RDS instance) — we consider the RDS a boundary
  * Internal analytics/metrics (we push telemetry to BigQuery) — if you store logs we need log-retention policy info

- We’ll need details for:
  1) How long KV caches and embeddings are retained by Redwood by default and what retention controls exist.
  2) Network adjacency: do you support private endpoints / VPC peering or does traffic go over the public internet (TLS)?
  3) Data deletion / export procedures for customer data.

I attached our network diagram (acme-net-diagram-v1.pdf) to show the boundaries. I’ll start filling the questionnaire; expect a first pass later today.

I think a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow (16 Jun) at 10:00 PT works for our team if that’s available. Susan — can you confirm procurement path?

—Alex
Alex Jensen
Security Engineer, Acme Health
alex.jensen@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme-net-diagram-v1.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@acmehealth.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — buyer roles + security kickoff

Perfect — thanks Alex. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

Inline:
- Retention: by default we keep inference KV caches per-model for up to 24 hours; embeddings retention is configurable per-customer (default 90 days). We support customer-managed retention policies and can provide a retention SOP for procurement/security.
- Networking: hosted Redwood endpoints are public TLS by default. For Dedicated/Private customers we offer a VPC private endpoint option and bring-your-own VPC setup — we’ll include the VPC peering option in the intake.
- Deletion/export: we support data export via secure S3 export and have documented deletion APIs; we’ll send the API spec in the security packet.

Next steps I can own from our side:
- Diego will prepare a short security packet (SLA/retention/API spec) and a template SOW.
- I’ll schedule the kickoff for tomorrow 16 Jun 10:00 PT and send a calendar invite with a short agenda (30 min).
- Susan — if procurement requires an initial purchase order or internal requisition number, please share. If you prefer, we can start with an NDA (DocuSign) while procurement routes the PO.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) Complete questionnaire (Alex) — due EOD 16 Jun
2) Security kickoff + packet delivery (Redwood) — 16 Jun 10:00 PT
3) Procurement review and legal redlines (Acme) — target week of 22 Jun
4) Pilot/PO for dedicated evaluation — target early July

I attached the questionnaire again and a placeholder DocuSign link.

Thanks — Camila

Attachments: redwood-prelim-questionnaire.pdf, nda-docusign-link.txt

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Camila / Diego — quick note from a sales-ops perspective to keep the timeline tight: 

- If Acme is targeting a pilot in early July, we should prepare a one-page SOW placeholder and an estimated cost for a 4-week pilot (dedicated mini-pool + monitoring). Diego — can you draft a short SOW and the pilot pricing by EOD 18 Jun?
- Also flagging legal on the NDA and our standard terms; I’ll open an initial ticket with legal so redlines can be triaged quickly.

I’ll join the 16 Jun kickoff to listen in.

Marcus Lin
Sales Director | Redwood Inference

- Economic buyer: Susan Park (me). Procurement path: procurement@acmehealth.com will handle purchase orders; initial PO routing typically takes 5–7 business days after legal confirms terms.

- Kickoff: Alex confirmed he will join tomorrow 16 Jun 10:00 PT — I see the invite (accepted).
